'''Fett190 Shadows of the Empire (Dark Side)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fett190]]
* '''Published:''' 29 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 AOBS Fett190 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Has pretty much every charicter/starship in the bets selling novel!
